ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm (Seashell Blizzard) GPO-pushed scheduled task deploying wiper from non-standard path — Industroyer2 / CaddyWiper / Prestige pattern
ucs.description: Hunts for schtasks.exe /create commands that register a task pointing at an executable, DLL or script staged under PerfLogs, ProgramData, Windows\Temp, Users\Public or %PUBLIC% — the exact deployment shape Mandiant (Sandworm), Microsoft (Seashell Blizzard / Iron Viking) and CERT-UA attributed to GRU Unit 74455 for the April 2022 Industroyer2 ICS attack, CaddyWiper, and the October 2022 Prestige ransomware campaign against Polish/Ukrainian logistics. Sandworm reaches a domain controller, drops the wiper payload to a non-standard directory, and then mass-deploys it via a GPO-injected scheduled t
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="schtasks.exe" AND Processes.process="*/create*" AND (Processes.process="*\\PerfLogs\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\$Recycle.Bin\\*" OR Processes.process="*%PUBLIC%*" OR Processes.process="*%ProgramData%*" OR Processes.process="*%TEMP%*") AND (Processes.process="*.exe*" OR Processes.process="*.dll*" OR Processes.process="*.bat*" OR Processes.process="*.ps1*" OR Processes.process="*.vbs*") AND NOT Processes.user="*$" AND NOT Processes.parent_process_name IN ("msiexec.exe","trustedinstaller.exe","setup.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime), ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// Sandworm / Seashell Blizzard signature: schtasks /create targeting a binary
// in a non-standard staging directory — CaddyWiper (2022), Industroyer2 (April 2022),
// Prestige ransomware (October 2022) all rode this exact deployment shape via GPO.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName =~ "schtasks.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "/create"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    @"\PerfLogs\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Windows\Temp\",
    @"\Users\Public\", @"\$Recycle.Bin\", @"\Intel\",
    "%PUBLIC%", "%ProgramData%", "%TEMP%")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".exe", ".dll", ".bat", ".ps1", ".vbs")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"                                  // exclude machine accounts
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","trustedinstaller.exe","setup.exe","officeclicktorun.exe")
| extend WiperStaging = extract(@"(?i)([A-Za-z]:\\(?:PerfLogs|ProgramData|Windows\\Temp|Users\\Public|Intel|\$Recycle\.Bin)\\[^\s\"]+\.(?:exe|dll|bat|ps1|vbs))", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine,
          WiperStaging, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessParentFileName, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Same Sandworm GPO-wiper pattern translated to Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688.
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith @"\schtasks.exe"
| where CommandLine has "/create"
| where CommandLine has_any (
    @"\PerfLogs\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Windows\Temp\",
    @"\Users\Public\", @"\$Recycle.Bin\", @"\Intel\",
    "%PUBLIC%", "%ProgramData%", "%TEMP%")
| where CommandLine has_any (".exe", ".dll", ".bat", ".ps1", ".vbs")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName !endswith @"\msiexec.exe"
   and ParentProcessName !endswith @"\TrustedInstaller.exe"
| extend WiperStaging = extract(@"(?i)([A-Za-z]:\\(?:PerfLogs|ProgramData|Windows\\Temp|Users\\Public|Intel|\$Recycle\.Bin)\\[^\s\"]+\.(?:exe|dll|bat|ps1|vbs))", 1, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          WiperStaging, ParentProcessName, LogonId
| order by TimeGenerated desc

description: Detects schtasks.exe /create registering a task that targets an executable, DLL or script staged under a non-standard directory used by Sandworm (GRU Unit 74455 / Seashell Blizzard) for CaddyWiper, Industroyer2 and Prestige deployments via GPO.

logsource:

detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
  selection_create:
    CommandLine|contains: '/create'

    CommandLine|contains:

      - '\Windows\Temp\'

      - '\$Recycle.Bin\'
      - '\Intel\'

  condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*
falsepositives:

ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm pre-detonation destructive prep — shadow copy delete + event log clear + boot-recovery disable converging in a 5-minute window
ucs.description: Hunts for the convergence of recovery-removal LOLBin behaviours that Sandworm runs immediately before triggering a wiper or pseudo-ransomware (NotPetya 2017, BadRabbit, Olympic Destroyer 2018, Prestige 2022, RansomBoggs 2022). The detection requires at least two distinct destructive categories — VSS shadow delete, event-log clear, BCD recovery disable, or sdelete/cipher mass wipe — within a 5-minute window on the same host. Individually each is noisy; the combination is signature-grade Sandworm endgame.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.process_name) as binaries from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND Processes.process="*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="wevtutil.exe" AND (Processes.process="*cl *" OR Processes.process="*clear-log*")) OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name="sdelete.exe" AND (Processes.process="* -p *" OR Processes.process="* /p *" OR Processes.process="* -s *")) OR (Processes.process_name="sdelete64.exe") OR (Processes.process_name="cipher.exe" AND Processes.process="*/w:*") OR (Processes.process_name="fsutil.exe" AND Processes.process="*usn*deletejournal*")) by host Processes.user span=5m | eval technique=case(match(commands,"(?i)vssadmin|shadowcopy"),"VSS_DELETE",match(commands,"(?i)wevtutil"),"LOG_CLEAR",match(commands,"(?i)bcdedit"),"RECOVERY_DISABLE",match(commands,"(?i)sdelete|cipher /w|usn.*deletejournal"),"MASS_WIPE",1==1,"OTHER") | stats min(firstTime) as firstSeen max(lastTime) as lastSeen values(technique) as techniques dc(technique) as techniqueCount values(commands) as commandSample by host Processes.user | where techniqueCount >= 2 | convert ctime(firstSeen), ctime(lastSeen) | sort - firstSeen
ucs.kql:
// Sandworm pre-detonation convergence: ≥2 distinct destructive categories
// on the same host within 5 minutes. Captures NotPetya / BadRabbit / Olympic
// Destroyer / Prestige / RansomBoggs endgame patterns attributed to GRU 74455.
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ConvergenceWindow = 5m;
let Destructive =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("cl ", "clear-log"))
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)recoveryenabled\s+no" or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures"))
         or (FileName in~ ("sdelete.exe","sdelete64.exe") and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s[-/](p|s|r|q)\b")
         or (FileName =~ "cipher.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)/w:")
         or (FileName =~ "fsutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "usn" and ProcessCommandLine has "deletejournal")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | extend Technique = case(
        FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe"), "VSS_DELETE",
        FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe", "LOG_CLEAR",
        FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe", "RECOVERY_DISABLE",
        FileName in~ ("sdelete.exe","sdelete64.exe","cipher.exe","fsutil.exe"), "MASS_WIPE",
        "OTHER")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
              ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Technique;
Destructive
| summarize Techniques = make_set(Technique),
            DistinctTechniques = dcount(Technique),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            CommandSample = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            InitiatingProcs = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, ConvergenceWindow)
| where DistinctTechniques >= 2   // 2+ destructive categories in 5m = Sandworm-grade signal
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ConvergenceWindow = 5m;
let Destructive =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend Img = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = CommandLine
    | where (Img endswith @"\vssadmin.exe" and Cmd has "delete" and Cmd has "shadows")
         or (Img endswith @"\wmic.exe" and Cmd has "shadowcopy" and Cmd has "delete")
         or (Img endswith @"\wevtutil.exe" and Cmd has_any ("cl ", "clear-log"))
         or (Img endswith @"\bcdedit.exe" and (Cmd matches regex @"(?i)recoveryenabled\s+no" or Cmd matches regex @"(?i)bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures"))
         or (Img endswith @"\sdelete.exe" and Cmd matches regex @"(?i)\s[-/](p|s|r|q)\b")
         or (Img endswith @"\sdelete64.exe")
         or (Img endswith @"\cipher.exe" and Cmd matches regex @"(?i)/w:")
         or (Img endswith @"\fsutil.exe" and Cmd has "usn" and Cmd has "deletejournal")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | extend Technique = case(
        Img endswith @"\vssadmin.exe" or Img endswith @"\wmic.exe", "VSS_DELETE",
        Img endswith @"\wevtutil.exe", "LOG_CLEAR",
        Img endswith @"\bcdedit.exe", "RECOVERY_DISABLE",
        Img endswith @"\sdelete.exe" or Img endswith @"\sdelete64.exe" or Img endswith @"\cipher.exe" or Img endswith @"\fsutil.exe", "MASS_WIPE",
        "OTHER")
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Technique;
Destructive
| summarize Techniques = make_set(Technique),
            DistinctTechniques = dcount(Technique),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            CommandSample = make_set(CommandLine, 25),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 10)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, ConvergenceWindow)
| where DistinctTechniques >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 ((@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) @CommandLine:(*delete* AND *shadows*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy* AND *delete*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wevtutil.exe OR *\\WevtUtil.exe OR *\\WEVTUTIL.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"cl "* OR *clear-log* OR *Clear-Log*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\sdelete.exe OR *\\sdelete64.exe OR *\\SDelete.exe OR *\\SDelete64.exe OR *\\SDELETE.EXE) @CommandLine:(*" -p "* OR *" /p "* OR *" -s "* OR *" /s "* OR *" -r "* OR *" /r "*)) OR (@Image:(*\\cipher.exe OR *\\Cipher.exe OR *\\CIPHER.EXE) @CommandLine:*"/w:"*) OR (@Image:(*\\fsutil.exe OR *\\FSUtil.exe OR *\\FSUTIL.EXE) @CommandLine:(*usn* AND *deletejournal*))) -@TargetUserName:*$
